exit: 0
--- stdout
Replay a vector set against a subject and print the receipt.

Stdout is the receipt when the run reaches a verdict: exit 0 when every scenario passed, 1 when one failed or the set checked nothing. Anything that prevents a verdict is exit 2 with the JSON report. With --out the receipt goes to DIR/receipt.json and the report to stdout.

Usage: oce verify [OPTIONS] --subject <SUBJECT> <VECTORS>

Arguments:
  <VECTORS>
          The vector set (`oce/vectors/v1`); mutant paths resolve against its directory

Options:
      --render <RENDER>
          When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr
          
          [default: auto]
          [possible values: auto, always, never]

      --subject <SUBJECT>
          The sequence the vectors check: CXF (`.jsonld`, `.cxf.json`), text (`.oce`) or wire (`.json`)

      --subject-form <SUBJECT_FORM>
          The subject's form; overrides the name
          
          [possible values: cxf, text, wire]

      --out <DIR>
          Write the receipt to DIR/receipt.json (atomically) and print the report on stdout

      --require-mutants-caught
          Exit 1 when a mutant survived; no receipt byte changes

      --deny-warnings
          Exit 1 when the subject warned at load or a scenario left a warning unmatched; no receipt byte changes

      --timings
          Measure the run into the receipt's timings, which receipt_id never covers

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
--- stderr
